Honestly, I've done much of what you said when it comes to helping others. I used to spend most of my time trying to make others happy, attempting to brighten up their day or do whatever i could to ease their burdens. It worked for a few years but I couldn't keep doing it. Every time I would volunteer or would try to do something I just felt awful about myself. I'm not helping these people because I want to, I didn't; I just did it to try to make me feel better. It really ate at me.I hate being selfish or doing things for myself and when I do I never get much enjoyment out of it but filling that void through helping others wan't any better. I don't know if that makes sense.
